tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Excision for CW subcomplexes] ↗ thm:excision-general ↗ def:cw-pair ↗ prop:cw-pairs-have-hep 1. ch2:2.24\group Singular Homology

If $A$ and $B$ are CW subcomplexes and $X=A\cup B$, then inclusion induces \[ H_n(B,A\cap B)\xrightarrow {\cong }H_n(X,A) \] for every $n$.

Proof

\sketch Both CW pairs are good, and the quotient spaces $B/(A\cap B)$ and $X/A$ are naturally homeomorphic. Apply the good-pair quotient isomorphism.

□
